detailed_findings.finding: The chosen representatives X_i are proved distinct using the pairwise distinctness of all ten points, which is exactly the needed step to infer |S| distinct non-c points.
The complement argument correctly converts |S| <= 2 into at least three indices whose pairs are fully colored c.

reason: The proof is a correct and complete counting argument. It defines the bad-index set S of pairs containing a non-c point, injects S into the set of non-c points by choosing one such point from each bad pair, uses pairwise distinctness to justify injectivity, concludes |S| <= 2 from the hypothesis that at most two points are non-c, and then deduces that at least three indices lie outside S, where both endpoints have color c.
